analysis: The runner waited for a second FD_WRITE event after packet 1. On an already-writable nonblocking Winsock socket, FD_WRITE is not guaranteed to re-fire merely because WSAEventSelect is called again. The timeout occurred before packet 2 send(). This is classified as a local transport-runner event-state defect, not a Ditoo protocol rejection.
correction: Wait for initial FD_WRITE once after RFCOMM connect, then call send() exactly once for each of the three frozen packets. Any partial send, WSAEWOULDBLOCK, or error on a later packet fails closed with no resend.
authority: Attempt-1 authority consumed; attempt 2 requires new explicit authorization.
